name: Ferienhaus Seehäusl
beschreibung:
Situated just moments from the picturesque shores of Lake Thiersee, Ferienhaus Seehaeusl provides wonderful conditions for a relaxing getaway. Its cosy interiors deliver every modern comfort for families and couples.

In summer, the lake is ideal for swimming and boating, while scenic walking paths ascending Mount Pendling and surrounding alpine pastures begin right outside.
kurzbeschreibung: Ferienhaus Seehaeusl in Thiersee charms with immediate proximity to the lake and welcoming alpine hospitality in Kufsteinerland.
